## Join Fortrea at Obesity Week in Washington from 14 till 17 November 2026


Join us to learn who Fortrea are and how we are striving to be the best CRO partner to innovative Biotech and Pharma companies to drive forward clinical trials with ease. Obesity Week is one of the world's leading scientific and clinical conferences focused on obesity research, prevention, and treatment. It is presented by Obesity Week in collaboration with The Obesity Society (TOS) and brings together researchers, clinicians, policymakers, and industry experts from around the world.
